Hi all — Mina here from Security. Patch & verification summary below for the two findings called out. I’m including the specific artifacts we can produce and how they prove remediation.

1) Finding 3.2 — RCE via unsanitized template rendering
- Fix: replaced legacy templating library with sandboxed renderer; added input validation and environment variable hardening.
- Evidence we can provide:
  - nginx-config-after-fix.txt (config snippet showing request size/location restrictions and updated proxy rules)
  - jira-7894 (ticket) — includes patch and test plan; link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-7894
  - pt_remediation_report_20270520.pdf (detailed write-up and verification checklist)
  - access-logs-20270501-20270522-anon.csv — filtered/redacted logs showing no exploit-triggering requests after patch deployment (timestamps, user-agent patterns retained, IPs redacted)
  - verification steps: unit + integration tests run in CI, and a targeted re-run of the pentest vector in staging (result: no reproduction).

2) Finding 4.1 — config drift caused weaker SSL/TLS ciphers on an internal endpoint
- Fix: rolled updated cipher suite via config management; enforced TLS 1.2+ for internal endpoints and added monitoring alert for cipher regressions.
- Evidence we can provide:
  - screenshot: mfa-config-screenshot.png (admin UI showing MFA enforcement toggled for admin accounts) — this demonstrates tightened access posture for privileged flows
  - nginx-config-after-fix.txt (same file includes TLS/cipher config)
  - jira-7901 (ticket for config enforcement, will include acceptance tests and monitoring rules)

Compensating controls and ongoing monitoring:
- WAF rule set updated to block known exploit payload signatures and rate-limit suspicious POST bodies.
- Runtime isolation: critical services moved to isolated node pools with stricter IAM roles.
- Audit & alerting: new Datadog monitor firing on anomalous template-rendering errors; weekly smoke test for known vectors.

Delivery plan: I’ll upload the artifacts to a secure Drive folder and attach the anonymized logs. Expect the upload by Fri 2027-05-21 17:00 PT. If FinPartner needs a separate signed attestation we can generate one next week.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
